chapter: Witch's Revelation: Instruction of Curious Form
act_title: Witch's Revelation: Instruction of Curious Form

quests.title: Witch's Revelation: Instruction of Curious Form

dialogue.t: Is it coming back to you yet, Qiqi?
Oh... Uhm... I'm sorry...
There's no need to apologize. We still have a long way before we get to the Palais Mermonia. Let's keep walking for now — I'm sure you'll remember where your home is soon.
Look, it's Qiqi! And she's with a Melusine. That's a combo Paimon wasn't expecting to see!
Ah! {NICKNAME}, and... Pai... Paimon...
You know Qiqi? Fantastic news! I ran into her while investigating near Lumidouce Harbor... Judging by her size, I figured she was a human child... She is a child, right?
I am... am...
Right, right! We go way back. We're the best of friends!
Hehe! Quick thinking! If Qiqi had said she was a zombie, it might've scared her half to death!
Yes... Best of... friends... That's right.
Well, this is a happy coincidence for sure. To be honest, this is the first time I've ever found myself completely at a loss...
I take it you know about her memory issues? She can hardly seem to remember anything besides her own name.
Qiqi gets like that sometimes.
Poor child. I was going to take her back to the Marechaussee Phantom and let her stay there for a while, but I hoped she might get some of her memories back on the road.
Since you're such good friends, I take it you know where she lives? It would save a lot of trouble if I could take her straight home.
We know... But it's, uhm, a very long way from here...
Very... long way...? Hmm... I followed a Seelie all the way to Lumidouce Harbor...
Huh? You remembered something? What happened before that?
Before... that... Dr. Baizhu took me on his rounds at Yi... Uhm, Yi-something-something... I went to gather herbs, and then...
Ooh! Baizhu took you to Yilong Wharf, right? Detective Paimon thinks she knows what happened!
Baizhu took Qiqi to visit patients at Yilong Wharf. She got lost while gathering herbs, saw a Seelie, and followed it all the way to Lumidouce Harbor!
Hehe, good thing Paimon and {NICKNAME} read Robben versus Chesterton! Simple deductions like these are a piece of cake for Paimon now.

dialogue.sit: You do know that book's a work of fiction, right?

dialogue.t: Aha! Well, that checks out! I'll take Qiqi back to Yilong Wharf right away. Dr. Baizhu is Qiqi's guardian, is he? He must be worried sick!

dialogue.sit: Wait... Those people in Barbeloth's prophecy...

dialogue.t: Oh, you're right! Paimon almost forgot about that. Barbeloth — are you there? Can you hear us?
No need to shout. I've been here all along. I simply didn't want to interrupt your conversation. Listening is the default state of any good fortune teller.
This Seelie's so-called guidance could also be considered the guidance of fate. Hehe... Since you're here, Qiqi, why not let me read your fortune?
For... tune...?
Oh dear, Barbie, allow me to interject. You're really not suited to talking to children, you know — you're scaring the poor girl.
Let me take this one. Now listen closely — this is how you deliver a little surprise gift.
Ahem... Little Qiqi, member of the Little Hexenzirkel, I'm the mother of your ally Klee — Auntie Alice, the greatest witch in the world.
Nice to meet you, Auntie Alice...
Ah, what a sweet, polite little child. Come now, let Auntie's friend, another great witch, throw you a wonderful surprise fortune-telling party!
Fortune-telling... party?
That's right! Look at the cards in front of you. Aren't they pretty? Do you like them?
I... like them...
That's wonderful! Now, can you pick one for me?
Uhm... Is this one alright?
Of course. And because you were so wonderfully well-behaved, that card is yours to keep!
Uh... Thank you?
Alright, Barbie, break time's over. Come help little Qiqi with her reading.
You don't need to shake me awake... I've been listening the whole time. Ah, upright Hanged Man.
Very few people draw this card.
That means you're very special, Qiqi.
It symbolizes transcendence and waiting, and also detachment from the everyday world.
There are shackles that bind you, but you yourself have no desire to break free from them.
Shackles... Do you mean... my orders?
At least on the surface, you wouldn't be wrong to understand things in such a way.
As for your future, all you need to do is wait. Of course, it's not like you lack for time... But... Oh my, how strange, how very strange...
Hold up a second! You're saying too much at once. Give the poor child a moment to breathe.
Let Qiqi savor her little gift first. You really do need to show a little more patience with children...
What do you think, Qiqi? Do you like your surprise?
This card is pretty... Thank you, Auntie Alice.
Aww, good girl — you did such a good job remembering Auntie's name. Auntie would love to chat with you some more, but it's time for you to go home.
If Auntie Barbie has more to say, then next time the Hexenzirkel meets, she can make a prophecy for every little witch who attends! Wouldn't that be lovely?
...Could you not add to my workload without asking me first?
Then it's settled! See you next time, Qiqi, and all of you witnesses, hehe.
Bye-bye... Auntie Alice... and Auntie Alice's... best of friends.
Phew... Is that all over now? Did those two voices just come from this doll? What kind of toy is this? It's so cute, where can I...
Ugh! No, that's not important right now. Qiqi, let's go find that Dr. Baizhu of yours.
...Mmhmm, it's time... Qiqi should go home. See you... next time, {NICKNAME}... and Paimon.
Card... Gift... Hmm... Pretty...
I think that's everyone I needed to see, but where's Qiqi? She can't still be gathering herbs, can she?
Perhaps you should prescribe yourself some medicine to stop you overthinking... There's still plenty of time left until her orders say to be back.

quests.description: You encounter Qiqi at Barbeloth’s fortune-telling booth…
